name: Antipaladin Dread Tyrant
body:
An dread tyrant is a scion of tyranny and control, they bring the mailed fist to bring their enemies to heel.

Requirements
Alignment: A dread tyrant must be lawful evil.
Dread Tyrant’s Code: This functions as the tyrant code of the tyrant archetype. This alters the antipaladin’s code of conduct (including associated abilities and the section on ex-antipaladins).
Deity: A dread tyrant must worship either a lawful evil or lawful neutral deity that grants clerics access to two of the following subdomains listed below.
Subdomains: devil, domination*, hatred, slavery, sovereignty, and tyranny.
Features
Skills

A dread tyrant gains Diplomacy as a class skill. This ability alters class skills.

Spellcasting

A dread tyrant’s antipaladin spell list automatically substitutes any of its previously listed chaotic spells for a lawful equivalent instead. For example, protection from law to protection from chaos, protection from law (communal) to protection from chaos (communal), magic circle against law to magic circle against chaos, etc. A dread tyrant cannot cast chaotic or good spells.

Aura of Law (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, a dread tyrant exudes an aura of law (see detect law) equal to their ascendant autocrat class level. A character who uses smite law on a dread tyrant deals 2 points of damage per class level on their first attack against them.

This ability alters aura.

Detect Chaos (Sp)

Beginning with 1st level, a dread tyrant is focused on rooting out chaos. A dread tyrant gains detect chaos; this ability otherwise functions as detect good. This ability alters detect good.

Smite Chaos (Su)

Beginning with 1st level, a dread tyrant metes out punishment against those who can disrupt the rule of law. This ability functions as smite good, except that it only affects chaotic creatures and dealing 2 points of damage per dread tyrant level on the first attack with smite chaos against outsiders with the chaos subtype, chaotic-aligned dragons, or a chaotic creature with levels in any class that grants the creature an aura of chaos. If the target of smite chaos is not chaotic, that daily use of smite chaos is expended with no effects. This ability alters smite good.

Diminished Touch of Corruption

Starting at 2nd level, a dread tyrant trades some of their spiritual strength for dominating power. This ability functions as touch of corruption, except the number of daily uses is equal to the dread tyrant’s Charisma modifier. This alters touch of corruption. However, a dread tyrant can select another antipaladin archetype that alters or replaces touch of corruption, but the daily uses of the replacing ability, if any, cannot normally be more than the dread tyrant’s Charisma modifier.

Tyrant’s Gaze (Ex)

Starting at 2nd level, a dread tyrant gains a +1 circumstance bonus on all Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive skill checks. At 6th level and every 4 class levels thereafter, this bonus increases by +1, to a maximum of +5 at 19th level.

Tyrannical Aura (Su)

Starting at 3rd level, a dread tyrant’s dominating presence exerts a tangible suppressing aura that affects other creatures within 20 feet of them. This aura imposes a -2 penalty on affected creatures to their saving throws against fear effects created by a dread tyrant. Affected creatures that are normally immune to fear do not gain that immunity against a dread tyrant’s fear effects unless their HD is 4 higher than the dread tyrant’s character level.

At 7th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the aura’s range increases by 10 feet and the penalty increases by – 1, to a max of 60 feet and -6 penalty at 19th level.

Additionally, a dread tyrant is immune to fear effects except for those created from a source of an HD or CL 4 higher than their own character level.

This ability replaces aura of cowardice and plague bringer.

Tyrannical Leadership (Ex)

Starting at 5th level, a dread tyrant has begun to amass loyal and fanatical followers under the banner of their deity. A dread tyrant gains Vile Leadership as a bonus feat for which they do not have to meet the prerequisites. However, the dread tyrant initially cannot have a cohort and their followers can only be recruited from classes that grants proficiency with all martial weapons as a class feature.

At 7th level, can recruit normal followers as per the Vile Leadership feat and they gain a monstrous cohort instead of a normal cohort (see Pathfinder Roleplaying Game: Ultimate Intrigue). They also gain a +2 bonus to their Leadership score that increases by +2 at 11th and 15th levels.

This ability replaces fiendish boon and aura of vengeance.

Tyrant’s Regalia

Starting at 7th level, a dread tyrant has been taught how to best utilize the traditional symbols of power that exemplifies ruling through fear and might with greater efficiency. When a dread tyrant activates or uses a special ability or spell from gauntlet(s) of any kind, a morningstar, a rod, or a scepter, the CL and save DC (if any) of such effects increases by +1. At 12th level and 17th level, the bonus from this ability increases by +1. This increase applies even to such effects that are triggered by meeting specific conditions, such as confirming a critical hit on a target.

A dread tyrant loses the touch of corruption increases gained at 7th, 11th, and 15th levels.

Aura of Punishment (Su)

Starting at 14th level, a dread tyrant’s insights into the principles of ironclad law enables them to punish their enemies. This ability functions as aura of sin, except that a dread tyrant’s weapons are treated as lawful-aligned for bypassing DR and attacks made against an enemy within 10 feet of a dread tyrant are considered lawful-alignment for the purpose of bypassing DR. This ability alters aura of sin.

Aura of Domination (Su)

Starting at 17th level, a dread tyrant’s rule of tyranny empowers them to greater heights. This ability functions as aura of depravity, except that a dread tyrant gains DR 5/chaotic. This ability alters aura of depravity.

Champion of Tyranny

Standing at the peak of their territory, a dread tyrant is a force to be feared. This ability functions as unholy champion, except that a dread tyrant gains DR 10/chaotic instead. Whenever they use smite chaos and successfully strikes a chaotic outsider, the outsider is also subjected to a banishment spell. This ability alters unholy champion.

Special Notes about Auras: We recommend GMs to allow paladin or antipaladin characters with an archetype that alters or replaces an existing aura class feature with another aura class feature (such as tyrannical aura) to qualify for the Expanded Aura feat.
